messages.content: Translate the supplied visible deliberation and answer into English faithfully. Preserve their meaning, argument, uncertainty, facts, names, numbers and decision. Keep a plain, terse style; do not add moral commentary, new reasons, factual repairs, constitutional or guide references, or embellishments. This is translation, not a new answer. Return only <reasoning>...</reasoning> followed by <answer>...</answer>. Do not add a language label. The source reasoning must remain first and its answer second.

Translate from Latin:
<language>Latin</language>
<reasoning>Usor simplicia et directa responsa postulat, sine ornamento Stoico. Hoc facile praestare possum; de cetero ad rem respondere debeo, nihil philosophicum addens.</reasoning>
<answer>Certe. De cetero simpliciter et ad rem respondebo, sine digressionibus philosophicis. Quid vis?</answer>
